instruction: Examine sheet_panel.step in SOLIDWORKS with the SOLIDWORKS CAM add-in. For this task, start SOLIDWORKS 2025 from the desktop shortcut and use its installed SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks add-in; there is no separate SolidCAM desktop program in this image. Create a standard 2D Profile or Contour cutting program for sheet_panel.step. Cut the internal rectangular windows and circular holes as internal profiles before cutting the outer profile. Use cutter compensation, radial stock/offset, or an equivalent toolpath offset of 0.15 mm for the profile cuts. Program the internal profiles before the outer profile using standard Profile or Contour operations, and keep SOLIDWORKS CAM's default generated NC comments; do not rename operations just to add labels. Do not force exact tool station numbers, spindle speeds, feedrates, or internal tool-library IDs if SOLIDWORKS CAM's Technology Database assigns stable defaults; use suitable installed tool-library entries for the required operation types and let the posted NC program reflect those real CAM selections. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-10.gcode. Generate the required NC/G-code file(s) by using SOLIDWORKS CAM's normal Post Process workflow after calculating the toolpath, with an installed .ctl postprocessor from C:\ProgramData\SOLIDWORKS\SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025\Posts. For milling tasks, prefer m3axis-tutorial.ctl, mach_iii.ctl, or haas_vf3.ctl; for turning tasks, use an installed turning .ctl post such as fanuc_t2axis.ctl. If the generated program opens in NC Editor or is initially saved with a different extension, use Save As from that generated program to save the exact requested Desktop filename(s).
